events.title: Great Indian Hackathon 2026
events.venue: Online (Google Meet for keynotes and internship)
events.organizer: Sahrdaya College of Engineering and Technology, Thrissur, Kerala
events.cost: 149 (listed as a paid event; currency not shown)
events.eligibility: College students. Listing says no coding experience needed.
events.theme: Android app development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
events.perks: 24-hour hackathon, 1-week internship, industry keynotes, MOOC course, certificate for everyone
events.summary: Fully remote Android hackathon you can do from home. The listing window runs Nov 1 to Dec 31; the exact 24-hour hackathon dates aren't stated.
events.warning: Registration closes 31 Oct 2026 at 11:59 PM IST. Register at konfhub.com/gih2026 if you want in.
events.fitReason: Zero travel, beginner-friendly, cheap, and comes with an internship and certificate. Lower score only because it's Android/Kotlin, not your usual web and AI stack, and registration closes tonight.

events.title: Hack With Bangalore 4.0
events.perks: Workshops, free meals and swag, internship opportunities with possible PPOs
events.summary: 8-hour in-person hackathon at Microsoft's Bengaluru office. Beginner-friendly, with workshops on the day.
events.warning: Sources disagree. Devnovate (the organizer) and Hackathon Radar list 14 Nov with registration until 7 Nov, but Internshala lists 30 Oct and shows it as closed. The daily check will keep verifying this.
events.fitReason: Free, open to beginners, at a big-tech office, with PPO chances. Your OctaHarvest team could go together, and it pairs with the Tech Summit three days later in one Bengaluru trip.

events.title: Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026
events.organizer: Dept. of Electronics, IT, BT and S&T, Government of Karnataka
events.cost: Paid; prices not published in sources checked. Student passes need a valid college ID.
events.eligibility: Open to students, entrepreneurs and professionals
events.perks: Hiring booths, internship contacts, mentorship sessions, startup pitch track
events.bring: College ID, a few printed resumes, portfolio links
events.summary: Karnataka government's 29th tech summit. Not hands-on coding, but strong for networking and seeing hiring booths and startups.
events.fitReason: Good for meeting startups and recruiters and seeing where AI is heading. Worth it mainly if you're already in Bengaluru for Hack With Bangalore.

events.title: DevFest Bengaluru 2026
events.cost: Not announced; last year had paid tickets
events.summary: GDG Bangalore's yearly Google developer conference. The 2026 date isn't announced. DevFest season runs Oct 1 to Dec 31, and last year's Bengaluru edition was on 6 December.
events.fitReason: Great talks on Google's AI tools and good networking, but there's no date or venue yet, so you can't plan around it.
